title: Camera firmware versions MV 6.0.1 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta camera firmware is now available on Fri, 21 Jun 2024

Bug fixes: Resolved an issue where restricted bandwidth mode uploads motion recap images when motion-based retention is enabled
Resolved an issue to ensure higher video recoding stability when an unsupported PoE standard is used on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
General: Improvements to vehicle tracking performance on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
Improvements to high-density object detection performance on MV33/MV93(x)
Improvements to object detection accuracy on MV33/MV93(x)

html:
Camera firmware versions MV 6.0.1 changelog

Bug fixes

  • Resolved an issue where restricted bandwidth mode uploads motion recap images when motion-based retention is enabled
  • Resolved an issue to ensure higher video recoding stability when an unsupported PoE standard is used on MV63(x)/MV93(x)

General

  • Improvements to vehicle tracking performance on MV63(x)/MV93(x)
  • Improvements to high-density object detection performance on MV33/MV93(x)
  • Improvements to object detection accuracy on MV33/MV93(x)
